title: 第十四章 谁敢与我一战
slug: 重生之战神吕布全本免费-重生之战神吕布最新章节列表
content_zh:
“哼，本将军岂是你这种势力小人所能揣度的。”吕布冷哼道。
袁术脸色变了又变，正欲怒骂，被袁绍用眼神制止了。
帐内的有些诸侯为吕布惋惜，武夫就是武夫，三言两语就经受不住，而孙坚等武将出身的诸侯看向吕布的眼神充满了敬佩，攻打董卓老贼乃是大势所趋，不为困难所惑，大义凛然，拯救大汉，乃是大丈夫所为。
“将军，诸侯的兵马一共有五万人，兵倒是不少，可能用的几乎没有，基本上都是一些老弱，我们并州军一个能挑他们五个。”曹性苦着脸说道。
“不能这么说嘛，你看，这里面不还是有骑兵助阵的嘛。”吕布遥指在队伍中鹤立鸡群的一部骑兵笑道，还别说，白马义从的卖相挺不错，一个个骑着白马，如同王子一般。
“将军，那是公孙瓒手下的白马义从，据说公孙瓒凭借三千白马义从，打的异族是人心惶惶，其他诸侯的兵马能比吗。”曹性苦笑道。
“白马义从，果然是不同凡响，与狼骑相较恐怕也是不相上下。”吕布点头道，暗想公孙瓒也是下了血本了。
整顿军队之后，吕布带领麾下两千骑兵加上一千白马义从，手持方天画戟，威风凛凛的立在汜水关下，朗声道：“吾乃九原吕奉先，谁敢与我一战！”
“战，战，战！”两千骑兵高举手中的兵器齐声吼道，在他们的带动下，诸侯的兵马亦是跟着大喊，声音渐渐汇聚在一起，响彻天际。
数万人齐声大喊的气势，一时间令关上的守军有轻微的窒息感，不过昨晚的大胜让很多将士镇定了下来，在他们眼中，诸侯联军不过如此。
“将军，吕布在关下搦战。”
“知道了，任何人没有命令不许出战。”华雄掩饰不住脸上的笑意，昨晚突袭大胜，功劳自然不必说，相国马上就到汜水关，经此一战敢问西凉军中谁人有他的地位高。
“将军，卑职愿往，斩吕布首级。”胡封出列道，昨晚的胜利让他心中有些小觑联军。
“吕布神勇，不可。”华雄谨慎的说道。
“哼，将军何必言他人之勇，丧我军之胆，卑职去去就来。”胡封提刀上马，胡轸是他的兄长，没想到死在了联军手中，他正想着报仇呢。
“唉，不知者无畏啊。”华雄叹道，在遇到吕布之前，他也曾一度以为，天下的武将不过尔尔，可是吕布的神勇却改变了他的认知，就算是大胜了一场，他也不敢懈怠。
关门缓缓会有人出战，莫非来人是高手？若是这副身体的主人，自然是不惧，可当下的吕布，估计也就是一流武将的水准，碰到关羽张飞这样的无人敌，肯定是打不过的。
“来将何人，报上名来。”吕布画戟一抬，冷喝道。
“吾乃西凉大将胡封，败军之将，还不速速受死。”胡封大喝一声，策马提刀向吕布杀来。
“没有这号人物啊。”吕布有些疑惑。

骑术还行，就是招式有些太慢了，力气也有些小了，交手不到三个回合，吕布就看出胡封是个不入流的武将，自己仅用了三成力就让他手忙脚乱了，完全不是一个档次的。
和胡封对战了十几合之后，他发觉没什么意思，对方的武艺对自己的提升不大，手中的方天画戟蓦然变劈为刺，锋利的戟尖直接穿透胡封的喉咙。
身后数万兵马得知吕布戟挑胡封，发出震天的吼声，经过一场大败的士气在呐喊声中缓缓回复着，与并州军一般，许多士兵看向吕布的眼神包含了一丝崇拜。
吕布神情微微一滞，这么近距离的用冷兵器杀死对手，难免有些不适“换一个中用的来。”
“将军神勇，将军神勇！”数万人齐声吼道，幽并二州，地处边疆，历来是崇拜武力高强之辈，白马义从也不例外。
“报，吕布数合将胡封将军斩杀！”
“知道了，密切关注诸侯军的动向，没我的命令，任何人不得出战，否则军法处置。”华雄冷声道，胡封要是不死，还不正常了呢，不过关内守军士气正旺，无需理会关外挑战的吕布。
“匹夫就是匹夫！”诸侯大营的袁术得知消息之后嘀咕道。
“袁将军，吕将军在关下浴血奋战，如今斩了董贼大将，有功，为何出言中伤？”一旁的孙坚按捺不住火气质问道。

content_en:
"Humph, how can this general be beyond the comprehension of a powerful villain like you?" Lu Bu snorted coldly.
Yuan Shu's expression changed again and again, and he was about to curse, but Yuan Shao stopped him with his eyes.
Some of the princes in the tent felt sorry for Lü Bu. A warrior is a warrior and cannot stand a few words. However, the princes with military backgrounds such as Sun Jian looked at Lü Bu with admiration in their eyes. Attacking Dong Zhuo, the old thief, was the general trend. They were not fooled by difficulties and were righteous. Saving the big man was what a man did.
"General, the princes have a total of 50,000 soldiers and horses. There are quite a lot of soldiers. They may be almost useless. They are basically old and weak. One of our Bingzhou Army can pick off five of them." Cao Xing said with a grimace.
"You can't say that. Look, there are still cavalry here to help." Lu Bu pointed at a cavalryman who stood out in the team and smiled. Not to mention, the white horse Yi Cong looked very good. They all rode white horses, like princes.
"General, that is Gongsun Zan's white horse loyal followers. It is said that Gongsun Zan, with three thousand white horse loyal followers, defeated the foreign tribes and made people panic. Can the soldiers and horses of other princes compare?" Cao Xing said with a bitter smile.
"The white horse's righteousness is indeed extraordinary. Compared with the wolf cavalry, I'm afraid it's on par." Lu Bu nodded, thinking that Gongsun Zan had also spent a lot of money.
After reorganizing the army, Lu Bu led his two thousand cavalry and one thousand white horse followers, holding Fangtian painted halberds. He stood majestically at the foot of Sishui Pass and said loudly: "I am Lu Fengxian of Jiuyuan, who dares to fight with me!"
"Fight, fight, fight!" Two thousand cavalrymen raised their weapons and shouted in unison. Under their leadership, the soldiers and horses of the princes also shouted, and the voices gradually gathered together and resounded throughout the sky.
The momentum of tens of thousands of people shouting in unison made the garrison at Guan Guan feel slightly suffocated for a while. However, last night's victory made many soldiers calm down. In their eyes, the coalition of princes was nothing more than that.
"General, Lu Bu is provoking a battle at the pass."
"Understood, no one is allowed to fight without orders." Hua Xiong couldn't hide the smile on his face. He had a great victory in the surprise attack last night. Needless to say, he deserves credit. The Prime Minister will arrive at Sishui Pass soon. After this battle, he dared to ask who among the Xiliang army has a higher status than him.
"General, I am willing to take this humble position and behead Lu Bu." Hu Feng came out and said. Last night's victory made him look down on the coalition forces.
"Lu Bu is so brave, you can't do that," Hua Xiong said cautiously.
"Humph, general, why should you talk about the bravery of others, the courage of our army, and the humble duty?" Hu Feng raised his sword and mounted his horse. Hu Zhen was his brother. He did not expect to die in the hands of the coalition forces. He was just thinking about revenge.
"Alas, those who don't know are fearless." Hua Xiong sighed. Before meeting Lu Bu, he once thought that the generals in the world were mediocre. However, Lu Bu's bravery changed his perception. Even if he won a big victory, he did not dare to slack off.
When the door slowly closes, someone will come out to fight. Could it be that the person coming is a master? If he were the owner of this body, he would naturally be unafraid, but the current Lu Bu was probably at the level of a first-rate general, and he would definitely not be able to defeat an invincible figure like Guan Yu and Zhang Fei.
"Who is coming? Tell me your name." Lu Bu raised his halberd and shouted coldly.
"I am Hu Feng, the general of Xiliang. I am a defeated general. I must die quickly." Hu Feng shouted loudly, then rode his horse and raised his sword to kill Lu Bu.
"There is no such person." Lu Bu was a little confused.
His riding skills were okay, but his moves were a bit too slow and his strength was a bit weak. Within three rounds of the fight, Lu Bu could tell that Hu Feng was an inferior general. He only used 30% of his strength to make him panic. He was completely out of his league.
After fighting Hu Feng for more than ten rounds, he found that it was not interesting. The opponent's martial arts did not improve him much. The Fang Tian painted halberd in his hand suddenly turned into a thorn, and the sharp halberd tip directly penetrated Hu Feng's throat.
Tens of thousands of soldiers and horses behind him heard that Lu Bu was challenging Hu Feng with his halberd, and they let out a roar that shook the sky. After a great defeat,The morale of the soldiers was slowly restored amidst the shouts. Like the Bingzhou Army, many soldiers looked at Lu Bu with a hint of admiration.
Lu Bu's expression froze slightly. It was inevitable that he would feel a little uncomfortable when he used a cold weapon to kill his opponent at such a close range. "Get a suitable one."
"The general is brave, the general is brave!" tens of thousands of people roared in unison. The two states are located in the border area. They have always worshiped people with strong military power, and Baima Yicong is no exception.
"Report, Lu Bu will kill General Hu Feng!"
"Understood, pay close attention to the movements of the princes' armies. No one can fight without my order, otherwise military law will be dealt with." Hua Xiong said coldly, if Hu Feng did not die, it would be abnormal, but the morale of the defenders inside the pass was high, and there was no need to pay attention to Lu Bu who was challenging outside the pass.
"An ordinary man is an ordinary man!" Yuan Shu from the princes camp muttered after hearing the news.
"General Yuan, General Lu fought bloody battles at Guanxia, ​​and now he has killed the traitor general Dong. It is a meritorious service. Why did you slander him?" Sun Jian on the side asked, unable to restrain his anger.
